Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

This privacy policy explains how PalHub ("we", "our") handles information when you visit our website at palhub1.pages.dev (the "Site"). PalHub is an unofficial fan resource and is not affiliated with Pocketpair, Inc.

1. Information we collect

We do not require you to create an account, and we do not collect personal information such as your name or email address. Like most websites, our hosting provider and analytics tools may automatically collect technical data such as:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and device information
  • Pages visited and time spent
  • Referring website

2. Cookies and advertising

We may use cookies and similar technologies to understand how visitors use the Site. If and when we display advertising (for example through Google AdSense), third-party ad networks may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You can opt out of personalized advertising at Google Ads Settings and aboutads.info.

3. How we use information

  • To operate, maintain and improve the Site
  • To measure traffic and understand which guides are useful
  • To serve and measure advertising, where applicable

4. Third-party services

The Site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Analytics may be provided by Cloudflare Web Analytics or similar privacy-friendly services. These providers process data under their own privacy policies.

5. Your choices

You can disable cookies in your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect your experience but will not prevent you from reading the guides on this Site.

6. Contact

Questions about this policy? Contact us by replying through the channel where you found this site, and we will respond as soon as possible.

7. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with a revised "last updated" date.

PalHub is an unofficial fan resource. Palworld is a trademark of Pocketpair, Inc. All game data is for informational purposes only.
